write_up: Your resume tells a clear story: you moved from order picking to leading outbound operations at Sierra Freight Distribution. A recruiter can see the work you manage and how many people are on your shift, though they'll have questions about the volume and results behind it.

The night-shift line is the model to keep. It names the team and the three parts of the operation you supervise. Your work history is easy to follow, and the OSHA and forklift certifications belong alongside it.

Let's start with the labor scheduling line: add the order volume you plan around if you can confirm it. Then explain what you handled when covering for the supervisor and what part you played in the scanner rollout.
